app.title: HACS Trends
app.tagline: Which Home Assistant custom repositories are gaining ground — and which look abandoned.
app.sources: Sources: HACS, Home Assistant analytics, GitHub
nav.heading: What would you like to find?
view.trending.title: Gaining attention
view.trending.help: Repositories picking up the most new stars in the selected period.
view.trending.note: Stars measure visibility, not use. Plenty of people star a project they never install — the {installed} view is the counterweight.
view.installed.title: Actually being used
view.installed.help: Ranked by how many Home Assistant installations are really running them.
view.installed.note: From opt-in Home Assistant analytics, so a large sample rather than a headcount — good for ranking, not for claiming exact user numbers. Integrations only: dashboard cards, themes and templates are not reported. {matched} of {withDomain} integrations are matched.
view.breakout.title: Rising fastest for their size
view.breakout.help: Growth in percent, so small projects are not buried under the big ones.
view.breakout.note: Repositories below {minBase} stars at the start of the period are excluded. The median across HACS is {median} stars — without a floor this list would be nothing but projects that went from 2 stars to 4.
view.momentum.title: Real momentum
view.momentum.help: Strong on both counts: gaining stars and gaining installations.
view.momentum.note: Ranked on the percentile of both rates, with each component rank shown in its own column — the placement is never a black box. Integrations only, and repositories whose domain is claimed by several projects are excluded rather than ranked on an ambiguous number.
view.maintenance.title: Possibly unmaintained
view.maintenance.help: Sorted by how long ago the last commit was.
view.maintenance.note: A prompt to look, not a verdict. A small, finished integration for a device with a stable API can be correct for years without a commit. Only {archived} is a hard statement. Across HACS the median is {median} days since the last commit; a tenth are past {p90} days.
view.new.title: New in HACS
view.new.help: Recently accepted into the HACS store.
view.new.note: Based on when a repository first appeared in our own collection, so this becomes meaningful from the second daily run onwards.
window.label: Period
window.starsExact: Star figures are exact for every period — the full history was collected once from GitHub.
window.installsGrowing: Installation and download trends have to build up over time. They start from {date}.
filter.searchPlaceholder: Search name, author, description or domain
hint.ambiguousDomain: Several HACS repositories claim this integration domain, so the installation figure cannot be attributed to one of them.
hint.noDownloadCounter: This repository ships without release files, so GitHub reports no download counter. That is not the same as zero downloads.
hint.starsAdded: Stars given during the period. GitHub does not report removed stars, so this is not a net change.
foot.downloadCoverage: Download counter for only {n} ({pct}%) — too sparse for a ranking of its own
foot.empty: Nothing matches. Try a different search or clear the filters.
